title: 12.8TB 3D TLC PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe U.3 SSD for Dell EMC PowerEdge Servers | Enterprise Drive in 14G 15G 16G Tray
description:
12.8TB NVMe SSD compatible in Dell servers with 2.5in SFF chassis and NVMe-capable backplanes.
Equipped with a 14th gen. Dell hot-plug caddy, forwards compatible in 15th and 16th gen. PowerEdge servers.
Similar to DPN's: 01VGG0 1VGG0 0NMCFM 0R3T9K NMCFM R3T9K
Designed for 24x7 availability in high data-workload environments.
Enterprise-grade reliability and performance, optimized for scale-out data centers.
Backed by a 2-year replacement warranty.
There are a number of backplane and riser combinations offered for 14th,15tn, & 16th Generation PowerEdge Servers. Specific options are required for NVMe PCIe U.3 SSD enablement.
